c74object.name: tap.garden~
c74object.digest: A generative event loop — the garden that plays itself
c74object.description: The tap.garden~ object is a garden you tend rather than play: the note message plants a note, which snaps to root/scale at entry, blooms on a soft two-operator FM bell, and returns every loop pass a step quieter (decay) and purer (soften) until it retires below floor. Left alone past idle seconds, a seeded gardener plants about one scale note per pass — deterministic per seed: same seed, same garden, bit for bit. The population converges by construction (per-pass decay is the stabilizer), a fixed sixteen-bell pool bounds the sound, and a sixty-four-event ring bounds the score, the oldest bloom yielding when full. Wrong notes are unrepresentable. A recreation of the published principle behind Eno/Chilvers' generative instruments.

inlet.digest: note messages plant; clear uproots; attributes tend.

method.name: note
method.description: Plant a note: MIDI pitch (fractional accepted) snaps to root/scale at entry; velocity 0..1 (default 0.8). The bell sounds on the next sample and the bloom returns at this loop position every pass until it fades below floor. Resets the gardener's idle clock. A full garden retires its oldest bloom to make room.

method.name: clear
method.description: Uproot everything: kill all blooms and bells, rewind the loop, re-seed the gardener, restart the idle clock. Parameters are kept.

attribute.name: loop
attribute.description: Loop length in seconds (0.25..120). Instant — the loop is a counter, no tape is bought; blooms keep their positions modulo the new length.

attribute.name: decay
attribute.description: Velocity multiplier per pass (0..1) — the stabilizer: a bloom lives ceil(log(floor/velocity)/log(decay)) passes, always.

attribute.name: soften
attribute.description: Brightness multiplier per pass (0..1): each return is purer, collapsing toward a sine as it recedes.

attribute.name: floor
attribute.description: Retirement threshold (0.0001..1): a bloom whose velocity decays below this is done.

attribute.name: bell
attribute.description: The bell as an attack/decay/brightness triple: envelope times in seconds, brightness 0..1 scaling the FM index. Applies to future blooms; ringing bells keep their envelope.

attribute.name: root
attribute.description: Root pitch class, 0..11 (0 = C). Instant; affects future plants only — nothing already planted re-pitches.

attribute.name: scale
attribute.description: The field plants snap to: chromatic, major, minor, majorpentatonic (default), or minorpentatonic. Accepts the symbol or the index (0..4). Instant; affects future plants only.

attribute.name: idle
attribute.description: The gardener's patience: seconds of silence before the garden starts planting for itself. 0 disables self-seeding entirely.

attribute.name: seed
attribute.description: The gardener's seed. Deterministic: same seed, same garden, bit for bit; different instances decorrelate by seed. 0 folds to the stock seed.

attribute.name: level
attribute.description: Master linear output level, slewed over smooth milliseconds.

attribute.name: smooth
attribute.description: Slew time for the level attribute, in milliseconds (0 = instant).
